fields.title: 📖 Revelation leads out of darkness into light
fields.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Through the Book, Allah guides those who seek His pleasure to the ways of peace and brings them out of darknesses into the light.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Ḥukm of Allah is light. Whoever replaces it with Hawā or Ṭāghūt leaves light and guidance.

immutable.source: 📝 aṭ-Ṭabarī und Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr zu Sūrah al-Māʾidah 5:16.
